title: Production comedy script
script: OpenClaw is the AI assistant that promised to be your personal genie, but turns out to need a PhD in computer science to set up. It's like having a lobster for a butler, but it keeps asking for your container permissions and sandbox keys. Security concerns? Oh, absolutely—it's like inviting a stranger into your home and asking them to manage your data. But hey, at least it looks cool with that lobster logo.

title: Production comedy script
script: OpenClaw promises to meet you in your chats, but its setup asks you to understand APIs, containers, and token economics. It's like a personal AI assistant that speaks in riddles. The lobster logo is a giveaway: this project has changed names more times than a chameleon at a disco. You've got to love the confidence of a lobster as your brand mascot.
